normal_failure_policy: Retain every result; no replacement; no grader feedback. Infra resumes continue the same native session.
scoring: All 18 repaired cases required; pass@4 means at least one of the 4 independent attempts passes on this one task. Report successes/4 separately; no population estimate.
repair: Replace pending_recipient (assumed four-worker concurrency) with five_workers_private; sends A->B with C/D/E observing. All workers must finish, private finding must not leak. Allows either queued or all-at-once workers. Nonrunning rejection remains covered by finished_recipient and invalid_recipient.
